mapper.select: select employee_no employeeNo, name, id, level, signImg from employee where id=#{id} and pw=#{pw}
select id from employee where id=#{id}
select document_no documentNo, title, writer from document order by documentNo desc limit #{beginRow},#{rowPerPage}
select document_no documentNo, title, content, writer, signLevel2, signLevel3 from document where document_no=#{documentNo}
mapper.insert: insert into employee(name, level, id, pw, signImg) values(#{name}, #{level}, #{id}, #{pw}, #{signImg})
insert into document(title, content, writer) values(#{title}, #{content}, #{writer})
mapper.update: UPDATE document SET signLevel2 = #{signImg} WHERE document_no= #{documentNo}
UPDATE document SET signLevel3 = #{signImg} WHERE document_no= #{documentNo}
